title: ITシステム応用
subtitle: Application of IT System
educationalGoal: The goal of this course is 1) to provide students with the basic knowledge to use a software for data analyses in psychological research and 2) apply the knowledge to actual data analysis.
advice: Recent psychological study requires researchers to use a software R, which enables various statistical analyses from basic ones (e.g., t-test, ANOVA) to multivariate analysis (e.g., regression analysis, factorial analysis). R is so useful that students make use of it in their PDⅢ, but so difficult to learn how to use it. Students should make use of office hours and peer instructions.
requiredKnowledge: Students can make use of their previous knowledge for data analysis during the course. It is expected to review the knowledge. Students have to bring their own personal computer for every class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to run the statistical analyses with appropriate methods.
Be able to run multivariate analyses with using R.
Be able to analyze data with applying an appropriate method and draw its figures and tables.
Be able to interpret the results of analysis and make an effective presentation.
